newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 surges through 4,900 after Dow record.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 surges through 4,900 after Dow record.

text.p: The FTSE 100 started the session on Wednesday more than one percent higher after comment on the U.S. economy from Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan sent the Dow to a record close.

The UK index surged through the psychologically key 4,900 points level, rising 60.2 points to 4,906.9 by 0738 GMT after Greenspan's upbeat address pushed the Dow to its fourth biggest day's points gain ever.
The U.S. index ended 154.93 up at 8,061.65.
"Greenspan has set the tone this morning but we are still waiting for the rest of his speech later," said a dealer.
